items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Mercer got him to do a musical of his, 'Top Banana' and I was called in to help Bill.

ctx.x: What kind of things did you do for Decca?

Whatever they needed; vocals mostly. Gordon Jenkins was sort of a house man there. But that collapsed when I got sick and that went for a year, getting over it. Meanwhile, Bill had been sojourning and came back and Johnny Mercer got him to do a musical of his, 'Top Banana' and I was called in to help Bill.
When did you first meet Bill?
